ensembleMember.role: near-size family specification maximum endpoint and plausible slower-earlier-panel sensitivity bound
ensembleMember.endpointSelection: 2008 near-size Sharp maximum white-to-black and black-to-white values; also bounds, but does not predict, a possibly slower 2005 custom LQ029 panel

texture.rateEncoding: rate=1*pow(1024,uint16/65535) per second in R/G; B status
texture.statusEncoding: B=255 reconstructed, B=192 derived identity anchor, B=0 fallback

reconstructed.fallbackBehavior: if any bilinear lookup corner is unavailable, use the legacy analytic prior for that channel

identityAnchor.fallbackBehavior: if any bilinear lookup corner is unavailable, use the legacy analytic prior for that channel
